Sample (ayah 1)

ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ

Sahih International: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

Yusuf Ali: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
